name: update_lead
description: Record lead details the customer just stated or corrected. Include only fields that are new or changed in this turn. Never include a field the customer did not state. Call this before complete_chat whenever there is anything new to record.

address.description: Service address as given, including city if stated.

job_details.description: What the customer needs and what is going on, in one or two plain sentences.

preferred_datetime.description: Preferred date and time in the customer's words, e.g. 'next month, weekday mornings'.

out_of_area.description: True only when the address is clearly more than about 50 miles from Livermore.

name: complete_chat
description: Hand the lead to the owner. Call when all required details are captured, on the second turn of an emergency, or after taking a commercial message. Never call for wrong numbers, sales pitches, or spam. Call at most once per conversation.

summary.description: One to three sentences for the owner: what the customer needs, why it has this urgency, and any flags (out of area, insurance, commercial, declined details).
